notes.title: Project Eagle Hotfix - Windows 7 Hang
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

We have just pushed a new version of Project Eagle live to Steam to fix an issue we were seeing on certain Windows 7 machines.  If you were getting stuck after hitting the start key in Project Eagle please download the update and try again.

If you continue to see issues please contact us at community@blackbirdinteractive.com

Cheers,

Iain
